name: spreadsheetRenameSheet
description: Renames a sheet in a workbook.

rustcfml.notes: Not supported on wasm32. Uses a different signature: spreadsheetRenameSheet(spreadsheetObj, sheetName [, sheetNumber]), where sheetName is the new name and sheetNumber is the 1-based sheet to rename (default 1). Member form: renameSheet(sheetName, sheetNumber).

examples.title: RustCFML: Rename the first sheet
examples.description: Rename the default Sheet1 to People.
